component.name: Wayland Share Bridge
component.summary: Share Wayland screens and windows with X11 applications

description.p: Mirrors a Wayland screen or window into an ordinary X11 window so that X11 and XWayland applications (WPS Office, Zoom, Feishu, Electron applications, browsers, OBS, ...) can share it. The source is picked from the tray menu, either through the compositor's direct capture protocols or, as a fallback, through the desktop portal.
